{{Quote|What's on the agenda for this afternoon?''"<br />"''You have a meeting with Adi Gallia, then a follow-up meeting with Bail Antilles and Horox Ryyder. After that, you are meeting with the representatives of the Corporate Alliance and the trade delegation from Ord Mantell. Then&mdash;''"<br />"''Enough.|Chancellor Valorum and Sei Taria discuss another busy day|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
'''Sei Taria''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] who served as [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] during the latter's tenure as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Taria worked for the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as early as [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]], a post in which she helped Valorum follow the Republic's myriad [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] policies and procedures. Taria became Valorum's lover, and she often accompanied him to social events as well as on [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] missions. In 37 BBY, she helped the Chancellor prepare for a visit to the capital by [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]] of the planet [[Vena]] by arranging a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escort for the woman.

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], as Valorum's popularity and hold on power waned, Taria helped him weather such conflicts as the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] and the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] actions of the renegade [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. However, she also grew close to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a rising star in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], in whom she could sense increasing power. When Palpatine and Valorum drafted a [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|resolution]] to tax [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|free trade routes]] in order to appease both the Nebula Front and its enemies in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Taria studied the proposed tax bill and additionally accompanied the Chancellor to a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] on the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] that was organized to finalize the proposed legislation.

The summit was prematurely adjourned when the entire [[Trade Federation Directorate]] was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and Taria, despite being soon after assaulted by agents of the terrorist organization known as [[the Flail]], dedicated her [[Time/Legends|time]] to gathering information on the Federation's new [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] leaders. The Neimoidians launched an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] as a means of protesting the taxation of free trade routes, and when bureaucratic procedure prevented Valorum from immediately sending aid, Taria could only watch from the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] as a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] ousted him from power. Although he was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|replaced]] by Palpatine, Taria chose to leave [[Politics/Legends|political]] life.

==Biography==
===Political ascent===
{{Quote|Scarlet figures prominently in the crest of my ancestral house.''"<br />"''And yet you favor black and blue in everything you wear.''"<br />"''I'm flattered that you notice.''"<br />"''Many have taken notice of you, Senator.|Senator Palpatine and Sei Taria, in 33 BBY|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Sei Taria hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and lived during the last [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> By [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]],<ref name="Last Stand">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 1]]</ref> she had begun a [[Politics/Legends|political]] career in the Republic's [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]. Based on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Taria worked directly for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as his [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> and a close [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]].<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|65|VAL 5-6|Finis Valorum}}</ref> In these capacities, she researched the procedural regulations of the Republic's [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]<ref name="db" /> and assisted Valorum in confirming and following them.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Taria additionally accompanied him on many [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] missions,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> attended official meetings of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and occasionally spoke publicly on the Chancellor's behalf.<ref name="db" /> The two became lovers,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and rumors of their affair reached the [[Ear/Legends|ears]] of others on Coruscant.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> As the Chancellor's Staff [[Aide/Legends|Aide]], Taria was a considerably wealthy woman.<ref name="db" />

[[File:Chancellorandconsort.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Taria and Chancellor Valorum await Baroness Omnino's arrival on Coruscant.]]
In 37 BBY, Taria prepared for a diplomatic visit to Coruscant from the planet [[Vena]]'s [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]], whom Valorum hoped to convince to join the Republic, thereby providing Coruscant with resource shipments from her [[Vena system/Legends|home system]]. Taria took precautions to ensure that the Baroness was not followed to the capital world by the radical [[Vena Isolationists]], who had marked their ruler for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Taria's offer of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escort was refused by Omnino, but Taria nevertheless arranged for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to pose as one of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] who awaited the arrival of the Baroness's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on a Coruscant landing platform.<ref name="Last Stand" />

As the ship touched down, Taria and Valorum stood on the platform and mused on Omnino's reasons for visiting. After their guest disembarked, she was greeted by Valorum just before [[Omnino's bodyguard|one]] of her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] was [[Assassination attempt on Baroness Omnino|fired upon]] by a renegade [[Unidentified Senate Guard (mind control)|Senate Guard]], who fled and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while trying to escape from Jinn's nearby [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. An angered Omnino made her way to Coruscant's [[Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals]] to await the arrival of her son, [[Sando (Baron)|Sando]], but when a Republic [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|beacon]] received a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from Sando's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], Taria and Valorum proceeded to the [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] to let the Baroness know. Jinn and Kenobi were immediately [[Mission to the Bright Jewel Cluster|dispatched]] to investigate,<ref name="Last Stand" /> and they eventually discovered that Omnino had used a [[mind control device]] to influence her bodyguard's assassin as part of a plot to destabilize the Republic and discredit the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], whom she blamed for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her [[Kindoro|husband]]. Jinn foiled her by [[Sai cha/Legends|severing]] her head.<ref name="Last Stand 3">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 3|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 3]]</ref>

Four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[33 BBY/Legends|later]], the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] staged an [[Yinchorri Uprising|uprising]] against the Republic due to the manipulations of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who hoped that the conflict would simultaneously kill Jedi and check the Yinchorri's warlike ways.<ref name="Acts of War 1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref> Several battles occurred between Jedi and Yinchorri forces,<ref name="Acts of War 2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref><ref name="Acts of War 3">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 3|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 3]]</ref> and Chancellor Valorum proposed to the Senate an [[Yinchorri embargo act|embargo]] of the planet [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. While the embargo was under consideration, Taria and Valorum attended a senatorial gathering at the [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] tower in the [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] of Palpatine, senator of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Palpatine was a close political ally of Valorum's; however, unbeknownst to the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], he was in fact [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, the mastermind of a [[Grand Plan/Legends|plot]] to seize control of the Republic. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] greeted his guests, and Taria deviously complimented him on both his modesty and his choice of attire. Palpatine then led them into the crowd of guests, and, after receiving a drink, Taria left her companions and began to converse with the [[Bail Antilles's wife|wife]] of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

[[File:Dontdoitfinis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Taria looks on as Valorum calls in political favors during the Yinchorri Uprising.]]
Valorum was ultimately forced to call in many political favors in order to see the embargo passed. He and Taria met with a group of senators in a [[Unidentified restaurant (Coruscant)|restaurant]], where the Chancellor received confirmation that they would support his proposal. Taria gave Valorum a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], which he used to converse with Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and share the news. Valorum also sent four attack groups of the Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] to assist the Jedi, and the Yinchorri were defeated.<ref name="Acts of War 4">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 4|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 4]]</ref> Taria continued to follow Palpatine's rising political star, and she grew close to the charismatic Senator.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Taria viewed him as a mentor<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|220|Taria, Sei}}</ref> and learned much from him,<ref name="db" /> and rumors persisted that she was romantically involved with Palpatine's aide, [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> At one point, Taria was mentioned in a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] report that also featured Senator Antilles.<ref name="Hero's Guide">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref>

===Trade troubles===
{{Quote|How good to see you, Sei. Are you all right?''"<br />"''I'm fine now, Senator. But it was terrible.''"<br />"''We will do all we can to protect the Supreme Chancellor.''"<br />"''I know you will.|Senator Palpatine and Sei Taria, in the wake of an attempt on Valorum's life|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
Later in the year, a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization known as the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] began to launch militant strikes on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a corporation believed by the Front's members to hold an unfair monopoly on galactic trade. Together with Palpatine, Valorum hatched a plan to subject [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|free trade routes]] to Republic [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|taxation]] in exchange for granting the Federation's request to augment their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|defenses]]. They hoped that such taxation would limit the Federation's power, appease the Nebula Front, and additionally enrich the Republic's outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Taria assisted the Chancellor with his plan<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> by studying the proposed tax bill.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Sei Taria}}</ref> Before the matter was brought to the Senate, Taria accompanied Valorum to a performance of the opera ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'' at the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]]. Their arrival at [[Valorum balcony|Valorum's balcony]] was delayed so that the Chancellor would be the last guest to be seated, but the entire audience stood up to applaud him upon their arrival. A group of twelve senators seated in their own balcony waited until Taria took her seat before returning to their own.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

[[File:Tariastanding.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sei Taria, aide to the Chancellor]]
When the bill was officially proposed, opposition in the Senate was strong enough that a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] on the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] was organized to discuss and finalize the resolution. After the Senate session concluded, Taria made her way through the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] to Valorum's [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|office]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. The plaza was filled with both supporters and detractors of the Chancellor's proposal, and Valorum's security detail recommended to Taria that he leave the building via rooftop platforms. Upon entering his office, Taria updated her boss on his meeting-filled afternoon and the suggested precautions, but he insisted on moving through the plaza itself as a show of good faith. Taria joined him and a triple-strength Senate Guard detail as he moved through the building's corridors and the crowded exterior [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|avenue]]. Before they reached a waiting [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], six Nebula Front assassins [[Attack on Supreme Chancellor Valorum|attacked]] the entourage. Two of the Senate Guards were killed, but the rest of their number, along with the nearby Jedi Masters Qui-Gon Jinn and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], were able to fell the attackers. A [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt struck Valorum in his side during the chaos, and he was rushed to the [[Galactic Senate Medcenter/Legends|Galactic Senate Medcenter]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

By the time Taria arrived at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], Palpatine was waiting outside of Valorum's treatment room. After he ensured that she was unharmed, he entered the room for a private visit with the Chancellor. The two agreed that a Jedi escort was needed for the forthcoming trade summit, and after Valorum recovered, Jedi Masters Yoda and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] visited him in his office. Taria received them outside and escorted them in before being subsequently dismissed. The Masters agreed to send representatives of their order to Eriadu, and Master Gallia led a four-Jedi&ndash;strong entourage that accompanied Taria, Valorum, and the rest of the [[Coruscant delegation]] to the summit. The delegation traveled to Eriadu and landed their ship at the planet's [[Eriadu Spaceport|principal spaceport]], from where a [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]] took them to the [[Wilhuff Tarkin's mansion|mansion]] of the world's [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|lieutenant governor]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. They were soon after whisked to [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City's]] [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]], the location of the summit itself, for a reception. There, Taria and Valorum were greeted by Tarkin.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

Following the reception, Taria and the others returned to the mansion, where Valorum was given temporary quarters. Taria continued to serve him at his ersatz office, and when Gallia, Jinn, and Kenobi arrived for a visit, she led them inside. The Jedi were concerned with the possibility of another Nebula Front attack, but none in the room could guess at the group's motives. However, Valorum wished to maintain the appearance of order, and he refused their requests to postpone the commencement of the summit. The next morning, as Taria and the rest of the Coruscant delegation waited outside the mansion for a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[caravan]] to take them to Seswenna Hall, Gallia and Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] arrived and informed them that the Nebula Front had breached Eriadu security. A stubborn Valorum consented only to enabling his vehicle's [[Force field/Legends|force field]], and the delegation made their way to the event.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

Delegations from a number of planets, the Trade Federation, and various other organizations met in Seswenna Hall, ignorant of the Nebula Front assassins and Jedi defenders battling on the building's roof. During the event's opening [[Music/Legends|musical]] fanfare, Taria was one of the first to notice a [[lightfight]] occurring in the hall's ceiling rafters. She announced it with a scream immediately before an [[Unidentified Nebula Front assassin|assassin]] plummeted to the floor. The present members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]] activated a force field around themselves, but everyone present watched in horror as several Federation [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security droids]] used the protection to fire on the Directorate members unchallenged. All thirteen [[Director/Legends|directors]] were killed, and the trade summit was prematurely adjourned. Secretly orchestrated by Darth Sidious, the murders had been arranged by the Nebula Front's [[Havac|leader]], [[Eru Matalis]], in order to allow the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] allies in the Trade Federation to assume sole control of the organization.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

===The Chancellor's fall===
{{Quote|Contrary to the claims of many a would-be political pundit, the passage of this bill demonstrates clearly that the senate ''[sic]'' has not grown too unwieldy or apathetic to act for the common good.''"<br />"''Would you consider this to be the high point of your administration?''"<br />"''Later today, the office of the Supreme Chancellor will issue a statement.|Sei Taria and a [[Unidentified Human correspondent|news correspondent]], following the ratification of Valorum's tax bill|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
[[File:Dontdismyboss.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Taria in the Grand Convocation Chamber]]
In the aftermath of the slaughter, Taria and the rest of her delegation returned to Coruscant. The tax bill was ratified by the Senate, and representatives of the [[Media/Legends|media]] afterward met Valorum and Taria outside of the Senate Building's [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] to field questions. Taria addressed the reporters on the Chancellor's behalf, praising both the bill and what had been accomplished on Eriadu despite the tragedy. She closed the discussion by informing them that the Chancellor would later issue an official statement. A cadre of guards then escorted them to Valorum's office, where he dictated a statement to Taria that she recorded on her [[Limb/Legends|wrist]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. His speech was interrupted by the arrival of Bail Antilles, who informed the Chancellor that he had been summoned to the Republic's [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] on charges of corruption and illegal enrichment.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

The Supreme Court had discovered that [[House Valorum/Legends|House Valorum's]] [[Valorum Shipping and Transport|shipping company]] stood to profit from taxation of free trade routes.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> With his reputation under fire, Valorum performed his job with renewed vigor and concentrated much of his efforts on ending the threat of a terrorist group known as [[the Flail]]. Members of the Flail had been attacking public utilities on Coruscant in protest of government policies, and when Valorum began to strike back at them, they sent him death threats and physically assaulted Taria. However, their threat was soon after ended by a special [[Valorum's agents|task force]] put together by the Chancellor.<ref name="Shadows of Coruscant">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref> Around the same time, Taria accompanied Valorum to an event in Coruscant's [[Perlemian Orbital Facility]]. As potential candidates for the next Chancery Election mingled with other politicians and powerful individuals, Taria and Valorum stood with a group that included Jedi Masters Yoda, Windu, and Gallia.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

As debate raged over whether or not the Republic in fact had the legal authority to tax free trade routes, the Trade Federation's new Neimoidian leaders augmented their [[Trade Federation fleet/Legends|battle fleet]] and used it to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] Naboo in protest<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> thereby preventing all shipping to the planet. Valorum dispatched Jinn and Kenobi to Naboo to negotiate with [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], and Taria assembled a dossier on both Naboo and the Trade Federation for the Jedi's perusal.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

{{RPG|"[[The Security Leak]]"}}
Seeking more information on the Trade Federation, Taria employed a trusted [[Sei Taria's troubleshooters|team of troubleshooters]] to purchase a [[packet of information]] from a [[Trade Federation brokerage house]] on the planet [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. An [[Sei Taria's contact|informant]] in the house was willing to provide the Republic with the information, and Taria gave the troubleshooters some rare and valuable [[Coin/Legends|coins]] to use for payment. When a [[Unidentified corrupt functionary|corrupt functionary]] in the Chancellor's office learned of the arrangement, he sold the troubleshooters out in an attempt to profit. Taria's team arrived on Corulag to find the informant dead, and they were forced to dodge both Federation security and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on their way back to Coruscant. Upon their return, they rooted out the traitorous functionary and confirmed that Taria was innocent of any wrongdoing.<ref name="The Security Leak">{{WizCite|story=The Security Leak|book=Secrets of Naboo}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

[[File:ZodKneelsBeforeAmidala-TPMHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Taria and Mas Amedda look on as a Vote of No Confidence is called in Valorum's leadership.]]
Jinn and Kenobi returned from Naboo with the world's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], as well as the news that the Federation's blockade had escalated into a full-scale [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]]. Valorum called a special session of the Senate to allow her to plead her case, and both Taria and Senate [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] joined him in the Grand Convocation Chamber's central [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]] as he chaired the session. When Amidala, seated in Palpatine's [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]], stated her allegations of an invasion, Trade Federation Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] demanded that a commission be sent to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to ascertain the truth of the claims. After a brief discussion with Taria and Amedda,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Valorum reluctantly conceded the point, citing procedural regulation [[Section 523A]]. On Palpatine's advice, Amidala responded by calling for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum's leadership. Senator [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]] seconded the motion, and a stunned Valorum requested a recess.<ref name="novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

Following the recess, Taria and Amedda returned to the podium alone. The session continued, and the Vote of No Confidence passed. Three candidates were nominated to replace Valorum: Senators Palpatine, Antilles, and [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]], the latter a representative of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Having found no help from the Republic, Amidala returned to Naboo and [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|captured]] Gunray with the aid of her [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]]. Palpatine's scheme came to fruition when he was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|elected]] the new Supreme Chancellor,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> and Taria afterward chose to leave political life.<ref name="CCG" /> A woman named [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] fulfilled her role in Palpatine's new administration, and rumors abounded that Moore had blackmailed Taria into retiring<ref name="Aliens Among Us">{{InsiderCite|96|Strangers Among Us: The Aliens Who Built the Galactic Empire}}</ref> or had otherwise eliminated her from public office. However, nothing was ever conclusively proven.<ref name="Sly Moore DB">{{DB|character|slymoore|Moore, Sly}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Security recommends that we leave by way of the rooftop platforms.''"<br />"''No. This was to be expected, and now is hardly the time for me to avoid my critics.''"<br />"''I told security you'd say that.|Taria and Valorum, planning their way through a crowd of protestors|<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />}}
[[File:Heysei.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Sei Taria: Politically astute, yet sometimes devious]]
Sei Taria was a petite woman<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> who stood 1.78 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall in adulthood.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Her skin was the [[Color/Legends|color]] of [[burrmillet]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]];<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were brown in color and her brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="website link" /> was often tied behind her head.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /><ref name="Last Stand" /><ref name="Acts of War 4" /> She was considered lovely,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and Finis Valorum found her attractive.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

As a close advisor<ref name="Fact File" /> and trusted aide to Supreme Chancellor Valorum,<ref name="website link" /> Taria was dedicated both to peace<ref name="CCG" /> and to approved procedure.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Although Valorum abhorred policy and procedure<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> and believed that they constantly caused him to compromise his morals, Taria helped him confirm and follow them,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> even when he displayed significant reluctance to do so.<ref name="novelization" /> Taxation became high on her political agenda<ref name="CCG" /> when Valorum proposed the taxing of free trade routes.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

Taria's working relationship with Valorum was casual,<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> and she sometimes spoke deviously to his peers.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> After many years of working under the Chancellor,<ref name="Fact File" /> Taria learned to anticipate his stubbornness and to accommodate it in times of crisis.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Their relationship grew into a physical one,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and the two often appeared in public together due to Valorum's desire to attend events alongside an attractive young escort.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> Senator Palpatine thought of Taria as Valorum's "trophy."<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Taria placed faith in the abilities of the Jedi and contravened Baroness Omnino's refusal to accept a Jedi escort during her diplomatic visit to Coruscant. Politically astute, Taria was able to discern some of the Baroness's motives behind the visit<ref name="Last Stand" /> and to sense Palpatine's increasing political power. She grew close to Naboo's Senator<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and learned much from him.<ref name="db" /> Nevertheless, Taria chose to leave political life when Palpatine replaced Valorum as Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="CCG" /> During Valorum's fall from power, Taria was slightly shaken by the murders and assassination attempts of which she found herself in the midst.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

==Equipment==
As Valorum's aide, Taria's favored attire consisted of expensive<ref name="db" /> burgundy [[Septsilk/Legends|septsilk]] robes<ref name="Cloak of Deception" /> that signified wealth when worn with a high [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] collar.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> She also wore a wrist comlink that included a recording function.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I had a walk-on role for a major film&mdash;Star Wars, Phantom Menace, as Sei Taria (Assistant to the Chancellor of the Universe&mdash;Chancellor Valurom ''[sic]''&mdash;Terence Stamp) Director: George Lucas.|Kamay Lau|<ref name="Kamay's website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starnow.co.uk/kamaylau|text=Kamay Lau|work=starnow&mdash;where talent gets discovered|archivedate=20161021193706}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kamaylauisseitaria.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Unreleased photos of Sei Taria can be found on Kamay Lau's website.]]
The character of Sei Taria was created for [[George Lucas]]'s [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. She appears in the Chancellor's Podium during the film's Senate sequence,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> but she is not identified in the script, which merely states that Valorum confers with Mas Amedda and "several of his aides" after being challenged by Lott Dod.<ref name="Classic Moment">{{InsiderCite|128|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: Vote of No Confidence}}</ref> The film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] similarly identifies Valorum as being in the company of his Vice Chair and "staff."<ref name="novelization" /> The [[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2|second issue]] of the film's [[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace|manga adaptation]] depicts Taria as standing to the Chancellor's right during the Senate sequence,<ref name="TPM Manga">[[Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace 2|''Star Wars Manga: The Phantom Menace'' 2]]</ref> while in the film, she stands to his left.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

In ''The Phantom Menace'', Taria was played by [[Wikipedia:British people|British]] actress [[Kamay Lau]].<ref name="Kamay's website" /> Her scene was filmed in front of a [[Wikipedia:Chroma key|bluescreen]] at [[Leavesden Studios]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Souvenir">''[[The Official Star Wars: Episode I Souvenir Magazine]]''</ref> Lau's [http://www.starnow.co.uk/kamaylau profile] on the talent directory website [http://www.starnow.com starnow] calls Taria the "Assistant to the Chancellor of the Universe," and includes two promotional photos of the character that have never been used in an official ''[[Star Wars]]'' product.<ref name="Kamay's website" />

Although unidentified in ''The Phantom Menace''{{'s}} script<ref name="Classic Moment" /> and credits,<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Taria was given a name in 1999's [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> She was first pictured in ''Star Wars'' media in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Scrapbook]]''.<ref name="Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Scrapbook]]''</ref> Taria additionally plays a relatively large role in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />

Taria's birth year has never been revealed in [[canon]], but ''Cloak of Deception'' states that in 33 BBY, she halves Valorum's age. However, Valorum's birth year is similarly unknown.<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />
